sources.title: Migration Act 1958, Compilation No. 172 (08/10/2026), ss. 7 and 42 (Federal Register of Legislation)
sources.said: 7 Act to extend to certain Territories (1) In this section, prescribed Territory means Norfolk Island, the Coral Sea Islands Territory, the Territory of Cocos (Keeling) Islands, the Territory of Christmas Island and the Territory of Ashmore and Cartier Islands. (2) This Act extends to a prescribed Territory. ... 42 Visa essential for travel (1) Subject to subsections (2), (2A) and (3), a non-citizen must not travel to Australia without a visa that is in effect.
